NewFAQ.Q1: What if I already have Claude Pro or GitHub Copilot?
NewFAQ.A1: You can use them for the AI agent — no extra API key. We auto-detect Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI on your system.
NewFAQ.A2: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and Amazon Bedrock for AI. Deepgram and Soniox for transcription. Plus the four CLIs above.
NewFAQ.Q3: Is my data really not touched by SeaMeet?
NewFAQ.A3: Yes. Your recordings, transcripts, and summaries go directly from your device to the provider you choose. SeaMeet servers never see them. We see only your subscription status and which provider you configured (not the key, not the content).
NewFAQ.Q4: Why pay $4.99 if I'm bringing my own keys?
NewFAQ.A4: The subscription pays for SeaMeet's app development — multi-provider routing, live transcription, wiki generation, AI agent with tool use, screenshot OCR, and ongoing platform support. Your AI cost is separate and goes directly to the provider (often free on Gemini's tier).

Device.LimitDescription: SeaMeet Pro works on up to 3 devices at a time. Sign out of a device you're not using to free up a slot.

Free.Q1: What can I do with the Free plan?
Free.A1: SeaMeet Free is a full-featured recorder and screenshot tool. You can record audio, capture screen video, take screenshots, and manage all your recordings — completely free, forever.
Free.A2: Yes. On the Free plan, no data is ever transmitted anywhere. All recordings, screenshots, and files stay 100% local on your device. Your privacy is fully protected.
Free.Q3: What more can I get with a paid plan?
Free.A3: Paid plans add AI-powered features: automatic transcription, meeting summaries, action items, live transcription during meetings, and AI-powered Q&A about your recordings.

BYOK.A1: BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key. You only need 1 API key — from either Google AI Studio (Gemini) or OpenAI — to power both meeting transcription & summaries and the AI agent chat. Google AI Studio usually offers a free key, so you can get started at no extra cost. Power users can also connect their own CLI tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for the AI agent chat. A guided setup wizard walks you through everything after checkout.
BYOK.A2: Your subscription funds continuous updates, new AI model support, bug fixes, and new features. API costs are paid directly to Google, OpenAI, or other supported providers using your own keys.
BYOK.A3: 1 account, up to 3 devices. Inactive devices are automatically freed after 30 days. You can also manually sign out a device to free up a slot.

Sync.A1: Sync Pro is a future tier with built-in AI (no API keys to manage), cloud sync across devices, and team collaboration. It's for users who want SeaMeet's AI features without bringing their own keys. Not available yet — click "Request this" on the plan card to email us if you'd like it, so we can prioritize.
Sync.A2: Recordings, transcripts, AI summaries, and action items are all synced across your devices. Changes on one device appear on all others.
Sync.A3: 1 account, up to 3 devices. Inactive devices are automatically freed after 30 days. You can also manually sign out a device to free up a slot.

Advanced.ModelHint: 2.5 extracts real names from on-screen chyrons. 3.1 is ~2.4× cheaper but currently labels speakers as [Speaker 1], [Speaker 2], …
Advanced.TurnCoverageAllInput: Every frame — best for on-screen names
Advanced.TurnCoverageHint: 2.5 default: only during speech. 3.1 default: every video frame (reads name plates even in silence).
Advanced.VideoQualityHint: Raise quality + max width when Gemini misreads small tile labels (e.g. Zoom/Meet/Teams participant names). Higher values increase image-token usage — 1280 px typically jumps from the 258-token to the 1290-token tier per frame.
Advanced.VadHint: Lower silence + HIGH end-sensitivity → shorter, more frequent transcript flushes.
Advanced.ActivityFlushHint: Experimental. Every N ms during a long turn, nudges Gemini to process accumulated audio. Does not currently segment turns on native-audio; enabling it will cause the whole recording to land in a single un-finalized turn.
Advanced.ActivityFlushRequiresManualVad: The periodic flush only takes effect when automatic VAD is disabled — the Gemini server rejects explicit activity control otherwise. Leave the toggle on and disable automatic VAD below to use it.

Privacy.OneSentenceSummary: SeaMeet Desktop keeps all recordings on your device fully local and private, and requires no account. Cloud features are optional, encrypted, and fully under your control.
TLDRItems: SeaMeet Desktop is private by design: everything stays on your device; we don't collect audio, video, screen content, or meeting data.
No account needed to use desktop app's non‑AI features.
Anonymous diagnostics are optional — off by default, and never include recordings or personal content.
SeaMeet Cloud is optional: only if you choose to upload or record via cloud do we process audio, transcripts, and meeting metadata.
Cloud accounts store basic info (name, email) and usage data for security and service quality.
Third‑party integrations are optional and fully revocable.
We don't sell data, and cloud recordings are encrypted.
You control your data — delete recordings anytime or request full deletion.
Privacy.TLDRTitle: SeaMeet Privacy — TLDR for Busy Humans

ExplicitApproval.Description: Auto-detect will NEVER start a recording automatically without your explicit approval.
ExplicitApproval.Title: Explicit Approval Required

MicrophoneActivity.Description: Auto-detect monitors your microphone use to infer which app uses it. No data is captured.
MicrophoneActivity.Title: Microphone Activity Only

NoDataAccess.Description: Auto-detect only detects whether microphone is used or not. It does NOT access any recorded data.

NoDataCollection.Description: SeaMeet does not collect ANY data from auto-detect feature without your consent.
NoDataCollection.Title: No Data Collection

EthicalUse.Description: Always inform and obtain consent from others before using Flashback to record them.
EthicalUse.Title: Ethical Use

LocalOnly.Description: Flashback runs entirely on your local machine. Nothing is synced to the cloud.
LocalOnly.Title: 100% Local

Protected.Description: Your privacy and security are paramount. Your data never leaves your device.
Protected.Title: Protected

RAMOnly.Description: All data stays in memory. Nothing is written to disk unless you save a Flashback recording.
RAMOnly.Title: RAM Only

Terms.OneSentenceSummary: SeaMeet is a free, privacy‑first recorder where local use requires no account, your data stays yours, cloud features are optional, and you must get consent before recording.
TLDRItems: SeaMeet Desktop is free — all non‑AI features work without an account or login.
Get consent before recording — SeaMeet doesn't check this for you.
Your recordings and transcripts are yours; SeaMeet only processes them to run as service.
Cloud features require an account and store data on SeaMeet servers.
Anonymous diagnostics are optional and can be turned off anytime.
Don't misuse of app (no illegal use, no hacking).
Service may change, and liability is limited.
Terms.TLDRTitle: SeaMeet Terms — TLDR for Busy Humans

deepgram.modelDefault: Auto (nova-3 for known language, nova-2-general for auto-detect)
deepgram.modelHint: Leave on Auto unless you have a specific reason. nova-3 has the best English accuracy but doesn't support every language in auto-detect mode — nova-2-general covers 36+ languages including Chinese.
deepgram.diarizeHint: Emit speaker labels (S0, S1, …) when multiple voices are detected.
deepgram.smartFormatHint: Punctuate, capitalize, and format numbers / dates.
deepgram.punctuateHint: Insert periods and commas based on cadence.
deepgram.keytermHint: One term per line. Domain-specific words to weight.
deepgram.keytermPlaceholder:

soniox.strictLanguageHint: Reject audio in other languages (faster but less flexible).
soniox.diarizeHint: Emit speaker labels when multiple voices are detected.
soniox.endpointingHint: Auto-finalize tokens when the speaker pauses.
soniox.contextHint: Free-form description of what's being discussed. Names, organizations, jargon.
soniox.contextPlaceholder:
Meeting with Acme Corp about Q3 revenue.
Attendees: Alice Chen, Bob Park.

openai.modelHint: gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize is best for diarization. mini is cheaper but no diarization. OpenAI caps a single upload at 25 MB of audio. SeaMeet extracts video as 16 kbps mono opus, so one upload covers roughly 3–4 hours of meeting.
openai.realtimeModelHint: gpt-4o-transcribe is the meeting default — server VAD finalizes each utterance with timestamps. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe is the same with lower cost. gpt-realtime-whisper has the lowest latency but accumulates the transcript on one growing line (no per-utterance finalization during recording) — best for chat UIs, not meetings.
openai.turnDetectionHint: Server VAD emits per-utterance transcripts as the speaker talks. Turn it off for push-to-talk flows where the buffer is committed only when recording stops.
openai.noiseReductionHint: Pre-filter applied to input audio before transcription. Choose the option matching your mic placement.
openai.includeLogprobsHint: Request log probabilities for each transcribed token. Used to color-code low-confidence words. Adds payload size — leave off if not needed.
openai.useStreamingHint: Show live partial text while a recording is being transcribed. Supported by gpt-4o-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe; ignored otherwise.
openai.contextPromptPlaceholder: Discussion of Acme Corp Q3 revenue. Attendees: Alice Chen, Bob Park.
openai.contextPromptHint: Free-form description that biases OpenAI toward domain vocabulary.
openai.contextPromptModelSupport: For whisper-1, the prompt is a list of keywords. For gpt-4o-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, the prompt is a free-text string (e.g. "expect words related to technology"). Prompt is not supported with gpt-realtime-whisper in GA Realtime sessions or with gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize.
